title: Gameplay settings profile
description: Camera, mouse and targeting settings (docs/DESIGN.md, settings suite, Gameplay page). The settings screen (M2) edits a copy of this profile; the game falls back to these defaults.

sensitivity_deg_per_px.description: Degrees the camera or character turns per pixel of mouse travel

click_max_drag_px.description: A button press that moves less than this before release is a click (targets), not a drag

keyboard_turn_deg_s.description: Turn speed with the turn keys (A/D by default)

zoom_step_ratio.description: Each wheel notch changes the distance by this fraction (at least 0.5 m)

zoom_smoothing_per_s.description: Exponential approach rate of the shown distance toward the zoom target

pitch_min_deg.description: Lowest camera elevation above the pivot (negative = below, looking up)

pivot_height_m.description: Height above the character's feet the camera orbits and looks at (shoulder height)

collision_radius_m.description: The camera stays this far from walls, pillars and the floor

tab_max_angle_deg.description: Enemies within this angle of the screen centre count as in front of the camera

tab_angle_band_deg.description: Tab order: by angle from the screen centre in bands this wide, then by distance within a band

click_empty_clears_target.description: Clicking empty ground clears the target (false keeps it, the MMO convention)

pick_height_m.description: Height of the capsule a click must hit to select a unit
